title.zh: 卷八十二 晉書8: 少帝本紀二
title.en: Volume 82 Book of Later Jin 8: Emperor Shao 2
title.raw: 卷八十二 晉書8: 少帝本紀二 Volume 82 Book of Later Jin 8: Emperor Shao 2

sentences.zh: 天福八年秋七月丁丑朔，京師雨水深三尺。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, Tianfu year 8, dingchou new moon: in the capital rain waters were three chi deep.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou new moon in the seventh month of autumn, Tianfu 8, floodwaters in the capital stood three chi deep.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，許州節度使李從溫來朝，進封楚國公。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Xuzhou Military Governor Li Congwen came to court and was advanced in rank to Duke of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Li Congwen, military governor of Xuzhou, presented himself at court and was promoted to Duke of Chu.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以前河陽節度使皇甫遇為右龍武統軍。

translations.literal: On renwu, the former Heyang Military Governor Huangfu Yu was made Right Dragon Martial Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu former Heyang governor Huangfu Yu was appointed Right Dragon Martial commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以宣徽南院使李承福為同州節度使。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Palace Attendant of the Southern Bureau Li Chengfu was made Tongzhou Military Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Li Chengfu of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Attendants was made military governor of Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，改陜州甘棠驛為通津驛，避廟諱也。

translations.literal: On guisi, Gantang Post in Shaanzhou was renamed Tongjin Post, avoiding a taboo of the temple title.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Gantang Post in Shaanzhou was renamed Tongjin Post to avoid a title taboo.

sentences.zh: 甲午，正衙命冊皇太后，以宰臣李崧充使，右散騎常侍李慎儀為副。

translations.literal: On jiawu, at the main court session orders were given to enfeoff the Empress Dowager; the chief minister Li Song served as envoy, Right Regular Cavalry Attendant Li Shenyi as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the main court ordered the enfeoffment rite for the empress dowager, with chief minister Li Song as envoy and Right Regular Cavalry Attendant Li Shenyi as deputy.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，幸南莊，召從駕臣僚習射，路左農人各賜布衫麻屨。

translations.literal: On dingyou, the Emperor visited South Manor, summoned the officials accompanying the carriage to practice archery, and each farmer along the road was granted a cloth shirt and hemp sandals.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he visited South Manor and had his escort officials practice archery; farmers along the route each received a cloth shirt and hemp sandals.

sentences.zh: 八月戊申，右衛上將軍楊思權卒，贈太傅。

translations.literal: Eighth month, wushen: Right Guard Senior General Yang Siquan died and was posthumously given Grand Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on wushen Right Guard senior general Yang Siquan died and was posthumously honored as Grand Mentor.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，分命朝臣一十三人分檢諸州旱苗。

translations.literal: On xinhai, thirteen court officials were separately assigned to inspect drought-stricken seedlings in the various prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai thirteen officials were dispatched to inspect drought damage in the prefectures.

sentences.zh: 涇、青、磁、鄴都共奏逃戶凡五千八百九十。

translations.literal: Jing, Qing, Ci, and Yedu together reported fleeing households totaling five thousand eight hundred ninety.
translations.idiomatic: Jing, Qing, Ci, and Yedu jointly reported 5,890 absconding households.

sentences.zh: 諸縣令佐以天災民餓，攜牌印納者五。

translations.literal: Among prefectural magistrates and assistants, five surrendered their seals and tallies because of natural disaster and starving people.
translations.idiomatic: Five county magistrates or assistants surrendered their seals, citing famine and disaster.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以前昭義節度使李從敏為左龍武統軍。

translations.literal: On guiyou, the former Zhaoyi Military Governor Li Congmin was made Left Dragon Martial Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou former Zhaoyi governor Li Congmin was appointed Left Dragon Martial commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 九月戊寅，尊秦國夫人安氏為皇太妃，帝所生母也。

translations.literal: Ninth month, wuyin: Lady An of Qin State was honored as Imperial Grand Consort—she was the Emperor's birth mother.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on wuyin Lady An of Qin State was elevated to imperial grand consort, the emperor's biological mother.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，追冊故魏國夫人張氏為皇后，帝之元妃也。

translations.literal: On dinghai, the late Lady Zhang of Wei State was posthumously enfeoffed as Empress—she had been the Emperor's first consort.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the late Lady Zhang of Wei State was posthumously enfeoffed as empress, his first wife.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以金部郎中、知制誥馮玉為檢校尚書右僕射，充潁州團練使。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Secretariat Drafter Feng Yu, Bureau Director of the Gold Department, was made Acting Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and assigned as Yingzhou Training Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Feng Yu of the Gold Department, drafter of edicts, was made acting vice director of the Department of State Affairs and training commissioner of Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊子，前潁州團練使田令方追奪在身官爵，勒歸私第，坐前任耀州日，額外配民曲錢納歸私室故也。

translations.literal: On wuzi, former Yingzhou Training Commissioner Tian Lingfang was stripped of all offices and titles still held, compelled to return to a private residence, on the charge that while previously in Yaozhou he had levied extra corvée money from the people and diverted it to his private household.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi former Yingzhou training commissioner Tian Lingfang was stripped of rank and ordered home, having extorted extra levies from the populace during his Yaozhou tenure for private gain.

sentences.zh: 延州奏，綏州刺史李彜敏拋棄城郡，與弟彜俊等五人將骨肉二百七十口來投，當州押送赴闕，稱與兄夏州節度使彜殷偶起猜嫌，互相攻伐故也。

translations.literal: Yanzhou reported: Suizhou Prefect Li Yimin abandoned the city and prefecture; with his brother Yijun and five others he brought two hundred seventy kin to surrender. The prefecture escorted them to court, stating that he and his elder brother Xiazhou Military Governor Yiyin had suddenly grown suspicious of each other and attacked one another.
translations.idiomatic: Yanzhou reported that Suizhou prefect Li Yimin had abandoned his post and fled with his brother Yijun and five others, bringing 270 family members to defect; they were escorted to court, having fallen out with his brother Yiyin, military governor of Xiazhou, in mutual attacks.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，夏州奏，差宥州刺史李仁立權知綏州。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Xiazhou reported that Youzhou Prefect Li Renli was provisionally assigned to act as Suizhou administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Xiazhou reported Li Renli of Youzhou provisionally administering Suizhou.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，故絳州刺史張從訓贈太尉，追冊皇后之父也。

translations.literal: On guisi, the late Jiangzhou Prefect Zhang Congxun was posthumously given Grand Commandant—he was being enfeoffed posthumously as the Empress's father.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi late Jiangzhou prefect Zhang Congxun was posthumously made Grand Commandant as father of the posthumously enfeoffed empress.

sentences.zh: 甲午，夏州李彜殷奏：「衙內都指揮使拓拔崇斌等五人作亂，當時收擒處斬訖。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Xiazhou's Li Yiyin reported: "Yamen Inner Director-in-Chief Tuoba Chongbin and five others rebelled; they were seized and executed at once.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Li Yiyin of Xiazhou reported: "Yamen inner director Tuoba Chongbin and four others had rebelled and were captured and executed.

sentences.zh: 相次綏州刺史李彜敏擅將兵士，直抵城門，尋差人掩殺，彜敏知事不濟，與弟五人將家南走。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward Suizhou Prefect Li Yimin presumptuously led troops straight to the city gate; men were soon sent to ambush and kill them. Yimin knew the affair would not succeed and, with five brothers, took his household and fled south.
translations.idiomatic: Then Suizhou prefect Li Yimin led troops unauthorized to the city gate; an ambush was sent, and seeing failure, Yimin fled south with five brothers and their families.

sentences.zh: 」詔：「李彜敏潛結兇黨，顯恣逆謀。

translations.literal: " An edict stated: "Li Yimin secretly joined with vicious partisans and openly indulged a rebellious plot.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict declared: "Li Yimin had secretly allied with traitors and openly pursued rebellion.

sentences.zh: 骨肉之間，尚興屠害；

translations.literal: Even among kin he still raised slaughter;
translations.idiomatic: Even among his own kin he brought slaughter;

sentences.zh: 照臨之內，難以含容。

translations.literal: within the realm of imperial grace he could hardly be tolerated.
translations.idiomatic: within the emperor's grace he could not be spared.

sentences.zh: 送夏州處斬。

translations.literal: Send him to Xiazhou for execution."
translations.idiomatic: He was to be sent to Xiazhou for execution."

sentences.zh: 」丙申，幸大年莊，遂幸侍衛使景延廣第。

translations.literal: " On bingshen, the Emperor visited Great Year Manor, then visited the residence of Palace Guard Commissioner Jing Yanguang.
translations.idiomatic: " On bingshen he visited Great Year Manor, then the home of palace guard commissioner Jing Yanguang.

sentences.zh: 延廣進金玉器玩，賜延廣玉帶名馬，母妻、賓佐、部曲、僮仆錫賫鹹及之。

translations.literal: Yanguang presented gold, jade, and curios; the Emperor granted Yanguang a jade belt and famous horses, and gifts reached his mother, wife, guests, retainers, and servants alike.
translations.idiomatic: Yanguang presented gold, jade, and curios; the emperor gave him a jade belt and fine horses, with rewards extending to his mother, wife, staff, retainers, and servants.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以右諫議大夫邊光範為給事中，以吏部郎中劉知新為右諫議大夫。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Right Remonstrance Grandee Bian Guangfan was made Attendant within the Yellow Gate; Bureau Director of the Ministry of Personnel Liu Zhixin was made Right Remonstrance Grandee.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Bian Guangfan was promoted to Attendant within the Yellow Gate and Liu Zhixin of the Ministry of Personnel to Right Remonstrance Grandee.

sentences.zh: 是月，諸州郡括借到軍食，以籍來上，吏民有隱落者，並處極法。

translations.literal: That month, prefectures and commanderies requisitioned army provisions on loan and submitted registers; officials or commoners who concealed shortfalls were all punished by the extreme penalty.
translations.idiomatic: That month prefectures requisitioned army grain and reported the rolls; any official or subject who concealed shortfalls faced capital punishment.

sentences.zh: 州郡二十七蝗，餓死者數十萬。

translations.literal: Twenty-seven prefectures and commanderies suffered locusts; those who starved to death numbered in the hundreds of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts struck twenty-seven prefectures; starvation deaths ran into the hundreds of thousands.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊申，制以吳國夫人馮氏為皇后，仍令所司擇日備禮冊命。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, wushen: by decree Lady Feng of Wu State was made Empress, and the responsible offices were ordered to choose a day and prepare the rites of enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on wushen Lady Feng of Wu State was made empress, with orders to schedule the full enfeoffment ceremony.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，封皇第十一妹為嘉興長公主，第十二妹為永泰長公主。

translations.literal: On gengxu, the Emperor's eleventh younger sister was enfeoffed as Princess Chang of Jiaxing, the twelfth as Princess Chang of Yongtai.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu his eleventh sister was made Princess Chang of Jiaxing and his twelfth Princess Chang of Yongtai.

sentences.zh: 是夕五更，有彗見於東方，在角，旬日而滅。

translations.literal: That night at the fifth watch a comet appeared in the east, in the Horn mansion, and vanished after ten days.
translations.idiomatic: That night at the fifth watch a comet appeared in the east at the Horn mansion and faded within ten days.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以權知延州軍州事、前鳳州防禦使杜威為延州留後。

translations.literal: On renzi, Acting Yanzhou Military and Civil Administrator, former Fengzhou Defense Commissioner Du Wei was made Yanzhou Surveillance Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Du Wei, acting Yanzhou administrator and former Fengzhou defense commissioner, was made Yanzhou surveillance commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以國子祭酒兼戶部侍郎田敏充宏文館學士，判館事；

translations.literal: On jiayin, Grand Master of the National University and concurrent Vice Minister of Revenue Tian Min was made Academician of the Hall of Illustrious Culture and directed its affairs;
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Tian Min, grand master of the National University and vice minister of revenue, was made academician of the Hall of Illustrious Culture and put in charge of it;

sentences.zh: 以吏部侍郎張昭遠充史館修撰，判館事；

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Personnel Zhang Zhaoyuan was made Compiler of the History Institute and directed its affairs;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhaoyuan of the Ministry of Personnel was made history institute compiler and put in charge;

sentences.zh: 以給事中司徒詡充集賢殿學士，判院事。

translations.literal: Attendant within the Yellow Gate Situ Xu was made Academician of the Hall for Gathering Worthies and directed its affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Situ Xu, Attendant within the Yellow Gate, was made academician of the Hall for Gathering Worthies and put in charge of it.

sentences.zh: 西京奏，百姓馬知饒殺男吳九不死，以其侵母食也。

translations.literal: Western Capital reported that commoner Ma Zhirao killed his son Wu Jiu but he did not die, because the son had encroached on his mother's food.
translations.idiomatic: Western Capital reported that Ma Zhirao struck his son Wu Jiu without killing him, the son having taken his mother's food.

sentences.zh: 詔赦之。

translations.literal: An edict pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: He was pardoned by edict.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以前延州節度使何健為涇州節度使。

translations.literal: On jiazi, former Yanzhou Military Governor He Jian was made Jingzhou Military Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi former Yanzhou governor He Jian was made military governor of Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以涇州節度使王周為陜府節度使。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Jingzhou Military Governor Wang Zhou was made Shaanfu Military Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Jingzhou governor Wang Zhou was made military governor of Shaanfu.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以左散騎常侍、權知開封府事邊蔚為工部侍郎，依前知府事。

translations.literal: On jisi, Left Regular Cavalry Attendant and Acting Kaifeng Prefect Bian Wei was made Vice Minister of Works and continued as before in charge of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Bian Wei, Left Regular Cavalry Attendant and acting Kaifeng prefect, was made vice minister of works while retaining the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以前兵部侍郎李玘為吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: On renshen, former Vice Minister of War Li Qi was made Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen former vice minister of war Li Qi was made vice minister of personnel.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，命使攝太尉、右僕射平章事和凝，使副攝司徒、給事中邊光範追冊故魏國夫人張氏為皇后，奉寶冊至西莊影殿行禮，鹵簿儀仗如式。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Envoy He Ning, acting as Grand Commandant, Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Grand Councilor, and Deputy Envoy Bian Guangfan, acting as Minister of Education and Attendant within the Yellow Gate, were ordered to posthumously enfeoff the late Lady Zhang of Wei State as Empress; they bore the precious registers to the Shadow Hall at West Manor to perform the rites, with guard and insignia according to form.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou He Ning as acting Grand Commandant and Bian Guangfan as acting Minister of Education were sent to posthumously enfeoff the late Lady Zhang of Wei State as empress, bearing the registers to the Shadow Hall at West Manor with full ceremonial escort.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁丑，以鄧州節度使宋彥筠為晉州節度使，以涇州節度使何建為鄧州節度使。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, dingchou: Dengzhou Military Governor Song Yanyun was made Jinzhou Military Governor; Jingzhou Military Governor He Jian was made Dengzhou Military Governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on dingchou Song Yanyun of Dengzhou was transferred to Jinzhou and He Jian of Jingzhou to Dengzhou.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以前鄴都留守、廣晉尹李德充為涇州節度使。

translations.literal: On jimao, former Yedu Garrison Commander and Guangjin Prefect Li Dechong was made Jingzhou Military Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao former Yedu garrison commander and Guangjin prefect Li Dechong was made military governor of Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙申，所司奏議，故天下兵馬都元帥、吳越國王錢元瓘謚曰莊穆，詔改為文穆。

translations.literal: On bingshen, the responsible offices submitted for deliberation that the late Commander-in-Chief of All Forces Under Heaven and King of Wuyue Qian Yuanguan should receive the posthumous title Solemn and Reverent; an edict changed it to Cultured and Reverent.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen the offices proposed the posthumous title Solemn and Reverent for late commander-in-chief and King of Wuyue Qian Yuanguan; the emperor changed it to Cultured and Reverent.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，遣前復州防禦使吳巒權知貝州軍事，詔節度使王令溫赴闕。

translations.literal: On wuxu, former Fuzhou Defense Commissioner Wu Luan was sent to act as Beizhou military administrator; Military Governor Wang Lingwen was ordered to come to court.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu former Fuzhou defense commissioner Wu Luan was assigned to administer Beizhou, and military governor Wang Lingwen was summoned to court.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，單州軍事判官趙嶽奏，刺史楊承祚初夜開門出城，稱為母病，往青州寧親，於孔目官齊琪處留下牌印，臣已行用權知州事。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Shanzhou Military Judge Zhao Yue reported that Prefect Yang Chengzuo opened the gate and left the city at the first watch, claiming his mother was ill and he was going to Qingzhou to visit kin; he left his seal and tally with clerical officer Qi Qi, and Zhao had already assumed provisional administration of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Shanzhou judge Zhao Yue reported that prefect Yang Chengzuo left the city at night, citing his mother's illness and a visit to kin in Qingzhou, leaving his seal with clerk Qi Qi; Zhao was provisionally administering the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，高麗遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Goryeo sent envoys with tribute to court.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Goryeo sent tribute envoys to court.

sentences.zh: 昭化軍節度使、瑞慎等州觀察等使杜建徽進封鄖國公。

translations.literal: Zhaohua Army Military Governor and Surveillance Commissioner of Ruizhou, Shenzhou, and other prefectures Du Jianhui was advanced in rank to Duke of Yun State.
translations.idiomatic: Du Jianhui, military governor of Zhaohua Army and surveillance commissioner of Ruizhou and Shenzhou, was promoted to Duke of Yun State.

sentences.zh: 遣侍衛步軍都指揮使郭謹領兵赴鄆州。

translations.literal: Palace Guard Infantry Director-in-Chief Guo Jin was dispatched to lead troops to Yunzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Palace guard infantry commander Guo Jin was sent with troops to Yunzhou.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙巳朔，遣左領軍衛將軍蔡行遇押兵士屯於鄆州，仍遣供奉官殿直二十六人，自河陰至海口，分擘地分巡檢，以青州節度使楊光遠謀叛故也。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, yisi new moon: Left Army Guard General Cai Xingyu was sent to escort troops stationed at Yunzhou; twenty-six Palace Service Officers of the Inner Hall were also dispatched from Heyin to Haikou to divide territories and conduct inspections, because Qingzhou Military Governor Yang Guangyuan was plotting rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi new moon in the twelfth month Cai Xingyu was sent to garrison Yunzhou with troops, and twenty-six palace officers were posted from Heyin to Haikou to patrol districts, as Qingzhou governor Yang Guangyuan was plotting rebellion.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，前左禦正齊國夫人吳氏巳降二十一人，並封郡國夫人，太后宮、皇后宮知客夫人等亦如之。

translations.literal: On gengxu, the former Left Imperial Rectifier Lady Wu of Qi State and twenty-one who had submitted were all enfeoffed as Ladies of Commandery or State; ladies who received guests in the Empress Dowager's and Empress's palaces received the same.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu former Left Imperial Rectifier Lady Wu of Qi State and twenty-one others who had submitted were all made ladies of commandery or state, as were guest-receiving ladies of the empress dowager's and empress's palaces.

sentences.zh: 太子太保致仕梁文矩卒，贈太子太傅。

translations.literal: Retired Crown Prince Guardian Liang Wenju died and was posthumously given Crown Prince Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: Retired crown prince guardian Liang Wenju died and was posthumously honored as crown prince grand tutor.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔河陽節度使符彥卿、宋州節度使高行周、貝州節度使王令溫、同州節度使李承福、陳州梁漢璋、亳州李萼、懷州薛懷讓並赴闕，分命使臣諸州郡巡檢，以契丹入寇故也。

translations.literal: On guichou, an edict ordered Heyang Military Governor Fu Yanqing, Songzhou Military Governor Gao Xingzhou, Beizhou Military Governor Wang Lingwen, Tongzhou Military Governor Li Chengfu, Chenzhou's Liang Hanzhang, Bozhou's Li E, and Huaizhou's Xue Huairang all to come to court; envoys were separately assigned to inspect prefectures and commanderies, because the Khitan had invaded.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Fu Yanqing of Heyang, Gao Xingzhou of Songzhou, Wang Lingwen of Beizhou, Li Chengfu of Tongzhou, Liang Hanzhang of Chenzhou, Li E of Bozhou, and Xue Huairang of Huaizhou were all summoned to court while envoys were dispatched to inspect the prefectures, as the Khitan had invaded.

sentences.zh: 遣給事中邊光範、前登州刺史郭彥威使於契丹，行至恒州，敵已犯境，不能進，留於公館數月，不達其命而回。

translations.literal: Attendant within the Yellow Gate Bian Guangfan and former Dengzhou Prefect Guo Yanwei were sent as envoys to the Khitan; reaching Hengzhou, the enemy had already violated the border and they could not advance. They remained at the guest house several months and returned without delivering their commission.
translations.idiomatic: Bian Guangfan and former Dengzhou prefect Guo Yanwei were sent to the Khitan but halted at Hengzhou when the enemy had crossed the border; they lingered at the guesthouse for months and returned without completing their mission.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《遼史》：天福八年二月乙卯，晉遣使進先帝遺物。

translations.literal: (History of Liao: Second month, Tianfu year 8, yimao, Jin sent envoys presenting the late emperor's relics.
translations.idiomatic: (History of Liao: In the second month, Tianfu 8, on yimao Jin sent envoys with the late emperor's relics.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，晉遣使請居汴，從之。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Jin sent envoys requesting to reside at Bian; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Jin requested residence at Bian and was granted it.

sentences.zh: 三月丁未，晉主至汴，遣使來謝。

translations.literal: Third month, dingwei: the Jin ruler reached Bian and sent envoys to give thanks.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on dingwei the Jin ruler reached Bian and sent envoys in thanks.

sentences.zh: 五月己亥，遣使如晉，致生辰禮。

translations.literal: Fifth month, jihai: envoys were sent to Jin to present birthday rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on jihai envoys were sent to Jin with birthday gifts.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉，晉遣使貢金。

translations.literal: Sixth month, xinyou: Jin sent envoys presenting gold tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on xinyou Jin sent envoys with gold tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋八月丁未朔，晉復貢金。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month, dingwei new moon: Jin again presented gold tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei new moon in the eighth month of autumn Jin again sent gold tribute.

sentences.zh: 己未，如奉聖州，晉遣其子延煦來朝。）〉

translations.literal: On jiwei, the Khitan ruler went to Fengsheng Prefecture; Jin sent his son Yanshu to court.)〉
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei he went to Fengsheng Prefecture; Jin sent his son Yanshu to court.)〉

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以單州刺史楊承祚為登州刺史，從其便也。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Shanzhou Prefect Yang Chengzuo was made Dengzhou Prefect, following his own convenience.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Shanzhou prefect Yang Chengzuo was transferred to Dengzhou at his request.

sentences.zh: 華州陜府奏，逃戶凡一萬二千三百。

translations.literal: Huazhou and Shaanfu reported fleeing households totaling twelve thousand three hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Huazhou and Shaanfu reported 12,300 absconding households.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，臘，車駕不出。

translations.literal: On yichou, at the La festival, the imperial carriage did not go out.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, at the La festival, the emperor did not go abroad.

sentences.zh: 詔前陜州節度使石赟率諸節度使畋於郡郊。

translations.literal: An edict ordered former Shaanzhou Military Governor Shi Yun to lead the various military governors in hunting in the outskirts of the commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Former Shaanzhou governor Shi Yun was ordered to lead the military governors in a hunt outside the capital.

sentences.zh: 太子賓客聶延祚卒。

translations.literal: Crown Prince Guest Nie Yanzuo died.
translations.idiomatic: Crown prince guest Nie Yanzuo died.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔宣徽使劉繼勛就杜威園亭會節度使統軍等習射。

translations.literal: On dingmao, an edict ordered Palace Attendant Liu Jixun to convene military governors, commanders-in-chief, and others at Du Wei's garden pavilion for archery practice.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao palace attendant Liu Jixun was ordered to gather military governors and commanders at Du Wei's garden for archery practice.

sentences.zh: 淄州奏，青州節度使楊光遠反，遣兵士取淄州，劫刺史翟進宗入青州。

translations.literal: Zizhou reported that Qingzhou Military Governor Yang Guangyuan had rebelled, sent troops to seize Zizhou, and abducted Prefect Zhai Jinzong into Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zizhou reported that Qingzhou governor Yang Guangyuan had rebelled, seized Zizhou by force, and carried off prefect Zhai Jinzong to Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 是冬大饑，河南諸州餓死者二萬六千餘口。

translations.literal: That winter there was severe famine; in the prefectures south of the Yellow River those who starved to death exceeded twenty-six thousand persons.
translations.idiomatic: That winter famine struck; south of the Yellow River more than 26,000 people starved to death.

sentences.zh: 開運元年春正月甲戌朔，是夕陣雲掩北斗之魁星。

translations.literal: Spring, first month, Kaiyun year 1, jiaxu new moon: that night battle clouds veiled the Chief Star of the Northern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu new moon in spring of Kaiyun 1, battle clouds that night veiled the Chief Star of the Northern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，滄、恒、貝、鄴馳告，契丹前鋒趙延壽、趙延昭引五萬騎入寇，將及甘陵，青州楊光遠召之也。

translations.literal: On yihai, Cang, Heng, Bei, and Ye sent urgent reports that Khitan vanguard Zhao Yanshou and Zhao Yanzhao led fifty thousand horsemen in invasion, approaching Ganling—Qingzhou's Yang Guangyuan had summoned them.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Cang, Heng, Bei, and Ye urgently reported that Khitan vanguards Zhao Yanshou and Zhao Yanzhao were leading 50,000 horsemen toward Ganling, summoned by Qingzhou's Yang Guangyuan.

sentences.zh: 己卯，契丹陷貝州，知州吳巒死之。

translations.literal: On jimao, the Khitan captured Beizhou; Administrator Wu Luan died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the Khitan took Beizhou; prefect Wu Luan was killed.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以宋州節度使高行周為北面行營都部署，以河陽節度使符彥卿為馬軍左廂排陣使，以右神武統軍皇甫遇為馬軍右廂排陣使，以陜州節度使王周為步軍左廂排陣使，以左羽林統軍潘環為步軍右廂排陣使。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Songzhou Military Governor Gao Xingzhou was made Overall Commander of the Northern Campaign Headquarters; Heyang Military Governor Fu Yanqing was made Array Marshal of the Left Wing of the Horse Army; Right Divine Martial Commander-in-Chief Huangfu Yu was made Array Marshal of the Right Wing of the Horse Army; Shaanzhou Military Governor Wang Zhou was made Array Marshal of the Left Wing of the Foot Army; Left Forest Army Commander-in-Chief Pan Huan was made Array Marshal of the Right Wing of the Foot Army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Gao Xingzhou of Songzhou was made overall commander of the northern campaign; Fu Yanqing of Heyang, Huangfu Yu of the Right Divine Martial Army, Wang Zhou of Shaanzhou, and Pan Huan of the Left Forest Army were made array marshals of the horse and foot wings.

sentences.zh: 太原奏，契丹入雁門，圍忻、代二州。

translations.literal: Taiyuan reported that the Khitan had entered Yanmen Pass and besieged Xin and Dai prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Taiyuan reported the Khitan had entered Yanmen Pass and were besieging Xin and Dai.

sentences.zh: 恒、滄、邢三州上言，契丹大至。

translations.literal: Heng, Cang, and Xing prefectures reported that the Khitan had arrived in great force.
translations.idiomatic: Heng, Cang, and Xing reported a massive Khitan advance.

sentences.zh: 是歲，天下餓死者數十萬人，詔逐處長吏瘞之。

translations.literal: That year, throughout the realm those who starved to death numbered in the hundreds of thousands; an edict ordered local chief officials in each place to bury them.
translations.idiomatic: That year starvation deaths nationwide ran into the hundreds of thousands; local officials were ordered to bury the dead.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔取此月十三日車駕北征，以前邠州節度使李周為權東京留守。

translations.literal: On renwu, an edict set the thirteenth day of this month for the imperial carriage's northern expedition; former Binzhou Military Governor Li Zhou was made Acting Eastern Capital Garrison Commander.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the northern expedition was set for the thirteenth of the month, with former Binzhou governor Li Zhou left as acting eastern capital garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，車駕發東京。

translations.literal: On yiyou, the imperial carriage departed the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the emperor departed the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，敵騎至黎陽。

translations.literal: On dinghai, enemy horsemen reached Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai enemy cavalry reached Liyang.

sentences.zh: 以侍衛馬軍都指揮使李守貞為前軍都虞候。

translations.literal: Palace Guard Cavalry Director-in-Chief Li Shouzhen was made Chief Controller of the Vanguard Army.
translations.idiomatic: Palace guard cavalry commander Li Shouzhen was made chief controller of the vanguard.

sentences.zh: 河北危蹙，諸州求救者人使相望。

translations.literal: Hebei was in dire peril; envoys begging rescue from the various prefectures were unceasing.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei was in crisis; plea envoys from the prefectures came one after another.

sentences.zh: 戊子，車駕至澶州。

translations.literal: On wuzi, the imperial carriage reached Chunzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the emperor reached Chunzhou.

sentences.zh: 以貝州節度使王令溫為鄧州節度使，時令溫弟令崇自契丹至，訴以舉族陷於甘陵，故有是命。

translations.literal: Beizhou Military Governor Wang Lingwen was made Dengzhou Military Governor; at this time Lingwen's younger brother Lingchong had come from the Khitan and pleaded that the whole clan was trapped at Ganling, hence this appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Beizhou governor Wang Lingwen was transferred to Dengzhou after his brother Lingchong arrived from the Khitan reporting that their entire clan was trapped at Ganling.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，鄴都留守張從恩遣人夜縋城間行，奏契丹主以鐵騎三四萬建牙帳於元城，以趙延壽為魏博節度使，改封魏王，延壽日率騎軍摩壘而退。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Yedu Garrison Commander Zhang Congen sent men who were lowered by rope from the wall at night and traveled by secret paths to report that the Khitan ruler had pitched his command tent at Yuancheng with thirty or forty thousand iron cavalry, made Zhao Yanshou Military Governor of Weibo, and changed his enfeoffment to Prince of Wei; Yanshou daily led cavalry to press the ramparts and then withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Zhang Congen of Yedu sent men over the wall at night to report that the Khitan ruler had pitched camp at Yuancheng with 30,000–40,000 cavalry, made Zhao Yanshou Weibo governor and Prince of Wei, and was daily pressing the ramparts before withdrawing.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以北京留守劉知遠為幽州道行營招討使，以恒州節度使杜威副之，定州節度使馬全節為都虞候，其職員將校委招討使便宜署置。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Northern Capital Garrison Commander Liu Zhiyuan was made Pacification Commissioner of the Youzhou Circuit Campaign Headquarters; Hengzhou Military Governor Du Wei served as his deputy; Dingzhou Military Governor Ma Quanjie was made Chief Controller; staff officers and generals were left to the Pacification Commissioner's discretion to appoint.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Liu Zhiyuan of the northern capital was made pacification commissioner for the Youzhou campaign, with Du Wei of Hengzhou as deputy and Ma Quanjie of Dingzhou as chief controller, with staffing left to the commissioner's discretion.

sentences.zh: 乙未，大霧中有白虹相偶，占者曰：「斯為海淫，其下必將有戰。

translations.literal: On yiwei, amid great fog a white rainbow paired with another; diviners said: "This is maritime excess; below there will surely be battle.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei a white rainbow appeared paired in heavy fog; diviners said, "This betokens maritime excess—battle is sure to follow.

sentences.zh: 」詔率天下公私之馬以資騎軍。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered that all public and private horses throughout the realm be levied to supply the cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict ordered all public and private horses nationwide levied for the cavalry.

sentences.zh: 丙申，契丹攻黎陽。

translations.literal: On bingshen, the Khitan attacked Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen the Khitan attacked Liyang.

sentences.zh: 遣右武衛上將軍張彥澤等率勁騎三千以禦之。

translations.literal: Right Martial Guard Senior General Zhang Yanzhe and others were sent to lead three thousand crack horsemen to resist them.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yanzhe and others were sent with 3,000 elite horsemen to resist them.

sentences.zh: 己亥，遣譯詔官孟守忠致書於契丹主，求修舊好。

translations.literal: On jihai, Interpreter-Edict Officer Meng Shouzhong was sent with a letter to the Khitan ruler seeking to restore the former good relations.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai interpreter Meng Shouzhong was sent to the Khitan ruler seeking to restore friendly relations.

sentences.zh: 守忠自敵帳回，契丹主復書曰：「已成之勢，不可改也。

translations.literal: Shouzhong returned from the enemy camp; the Khitan ruler replied in a letter: "The situation already formed cannot be changed.
translations.idiomatic: Shouzhong returned from the enemy camp with a reply: "What is already settled cannot be undone.

sentences.zh: 」辛丑，太原奏，與契丹戰於秀谷，斬首三千級，生擒五百人，獲敵將一十七人，賊軍散入鴉鳴谷，已進軍追襲。

translations.literal: " On xinchou, Taiyuan reported that it had fought the Khitan at Xiugu, beheaded three thousand, captured five hundred alive, took seventeen enemy generals; the rebel army scattered into Yamming Valley and pursuit was already advancing.
translations.idiomatic: " On xinchou Taiyuan reported victory at Xiugu: 3,000 heads, 500 captives, and 17 enemy generals taken; the enemy scattered into Yamming Valley and pursuit was underway.

sentences.zh: 二月甲辰朔，遣石赟守麻家口，何建守楊劉鎮，白再榮守馬家渡，安彥威守河陽。

translations.literal: Second month, jiachen new moon: Shi Yun was sent to hold Majiakou, He Jian to hold Yangliu Fort, Bai Zairong to hold Majia Ford, and An Yanwei to hold Heyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen new moon in the second month Shi Yun was posted at Majiakou, He Jian at Yangliu Fort, Bai Zairong at Majia Ford, and An Yanwei at Heyang.

sentences.zh: 鄆州奏，博州刺史周儒以城降契丹，又與楊光遠潛約，光遠引契丹於馬家渡濟河。

translations.literal: Yunzhou reported that Bozhou Prefect Zhou Ru had surrendered his city to the Khitan and had also made a secret pact with Yang Guangyuan; Guangyuan was guiding the Khitan to cross the river at Majia Ford.
translations.idiomatic: Yunzhou reported that Bozhou prefect Zhou Ru had surrendered to the Khitan and secretly coordinated with Yang Guangyuan to bring them across at Majia Ford.

sentences.zh: 時郭謹在汶陽，遣左武衛將軍蔡行遇率數百騎赴之。

translations.literal: At this time Guo Jin was at Wenyang and sent Left Martial Guard General Cai Xingyu with several hundred horsemen to go to their aid.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Jin, then at Wenyang, sent Left Martial Guard general Cai Xingyu with several hundred horsemen to reinforce them.

sentences.zh: 遇伏兵於葭葦中，突然而出，轉鬥數合，部下皆遁，行遇為賊所執，鋒鏑重傷，不能乘馬，坐畚中舁至幕帳。

translations.literal: He met ambush troops in the reeds and rushes who burst out suddenly; after several rounds of fighting his subordinates all fled. Xingyu was seized by the bandits, gravely wounded by blades and arrows, unable to ride a horse; he was carried in a basket to the enemy command tent.
translations.idiomatic: Ambushers burst from the reeds; after several clashes his men fled. Xingyu was captured, badly wounded, unable to ride, and was carried in a basket to the enemy camp.

sentences.zh: 遣李守貞等水陸進兵而下，以救汶陽。

translations.literal: Li Shouzhen and others were sent to advance by land and water downstream to rescue Wenyang.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shouzhen and others were ordered downstream by land and water to relieve Wenyang.

sentences.zh: 丙午，先鋒指揮使石公霸與契丹遇於戚城之北，為契丹所圍。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Vanguard Commander Shi Gongba met the Khitan north of Qicheng and was surrounded by them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu vanguard commander Shi Gongba met the Khitan north of Qicheng and was surrounded.

sentences.zh: 高行周、符彥卿方息於林下，聞賊至駭愕，督軍而進。

translations.literal: Gao Xingzhou and Fu Yanqing had just been resting in a grove; hearing the bandits arrive they were startled and urged their armies forward.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Xingzhou and Fu Yanqing were resting in a grove when news of the enemy startled them into advancing their troops.

sentences.zh: 契丹眾甚盛，被圍數重，遣人馳告景延廣，請益師。

translations.literal: The Khitan forces were very strong; they were encircled in many layers and sent men in haste to inform Jing Yanguang, requesting reinforcements.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan were overwhelming; encircled in multiple rings, they sent urgent word to Jing Yanguang for reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 延廣遲留，候帝進止。

translations.literal: Yanguang delayed, awaiting the Emperor's decision to advance or halt.
translations.idiomatic: Yanguang held back, awaiting the emperor's orders.

sentences.zh: 行周等大噪，瞋目奮擊賊眾，傷死者甚多，帝自禦親兵救之方解。

translations.literal: Xingzhou and the others raised a great clamor, glared and struck fiercely at the rebel host; many were wounded and killed. The Emperor himself led the personal guard to rescue them before the siege was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Xingzhou's men shouted and fought fiercely, with heavy casualties; only when the emperor led the personal guard did the encirclement break.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《宋史·符彥卿傳》：契丹騎兵數萬，圍高行周於鐵丘，諸將莫敢當其鋒，彥卿獨引數百騎擊之，遼人遁去，行周得免。

translations.literal: (History of Song, Biography of Fu Yanqing: Tens of thousands of Khitan horsemen surrounded Gao Xingzhou at Tieqiu; none of the generals dared meet their edge, but Yanqing alone led several hundred horsemen to strike them; the Liao men fled and Xingzhou escaped.
translations.idiomatic: (History of Song, Biography of Fu Yanqing: Tens of thousands of Khitan cavalry surrounded Gao Xingzhou at Tieqiu; no general dared meet them until Yanqing alone led several hundred horsemen in attack and the Liao fled, freeing Xingzhou.

sentences.zh: 《高懷德傳》：至戚城，被圍數重，援兵不至，危甚，懷德左右射，縱橫馳突，眾皆披靡，挾父而出。）〉

translations.literal: Biography of Gao Huaide: Reaching Qicheng, he was surrounded in many layers and reinforcements did not arrive; the danger was extreme. Huaide shot left and right, charged to and fro, and all the enemy scattered; he seized his father and broke out.)〉
translations.idiomatic: Biography of Gao Huaide: At Qicheng, heavily surrounded without reinforcements, Huaide shot and charged until the enemy broke; he carried his father out.)〉

sentences.zh: 登戚城古臺，置酒以勞三將，鹹咎延廣不遣兵赴難，相對泣下。

translations.literal: He ascended the ancient terrace at Qicheng and set out wine to reward the three generals; all blamed Yanguang for not sending troops to their aid and wept facing one another.
translations.idiomatic: He climbed the ancient terrace at Qicheng and feasted the three generals, who wept together blaming Yanguang for withholding reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 戊申，契丹築壘於馬家渡東岸，以騎軍列於外，以禦王師。

translations.literal: On wushen, the Khitan built ramparts on the east bank of Majia Ford and arrayed cavalry outside to resist the imperial army.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the Khitan fortified the east bank of Majia Ford with cavalry deployed outside against the imperial army.

sentences.zh: 李守貞以師搏之，遂破其眾。

translations.literal: Li Shouzhen engaged them with his army and broke their force.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shouzhen attacked and routed them.

sentences.zh: 敵騎散走，赴河溺死者數千，遂拔其壘。

translations.literal: Enemy horsemen scattered in flight; several thousand drowned rushing into the river, and their ramparts were then taken.
translations.idiomatic: Enemy cavalry fled; thousands drowned in the river, and the ramparts were captured.

sentences.zh: 初，西岸敵軍數萬，鼓噪揚旗以助其勢，及見東岸兵敗，號哭而去。

translations.literal: Earlier, tens of thousands of enemy troops on the west bank had drummed and shouted and raised banners to bolster their momentum; when they saw the east-bank army defeated, they wailed and departed.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier tens of thousands on the west bank had cheered and raised banners; seeing the east-bank force defeated, they wailed and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 獲馬八百匹，生擒賊將七十八人，部眾五百人，送行在，悉斬之。

translations.literal: Eight hundred horses were captured; seventy-eight rebel generals and five hundred troops were taken alive, sent to the imperial presence, and all beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: Eight hundred horses were taken; 78 rebel officers and 500 soldiers were captured, brought to the emperor, and executed.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，夏州節度使李彜殷合蕃漢之兵四萬抵麟州，濟河，侵契丹之境，以牽脅之。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Xiazhou Military Governor Li Yiyin united forty thousand Tangut and Han troops, reached Linzhou, crossed the river, and invaded Khitan territory to pin them down.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Li Yiyin of Xiazhou led 40,000 combined Tangut and Han troops to Linzhou, crossed the river, and raided Khitan territory to draw them off.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以彜殷為契丹西南面招討使。

translations.literal: On renzi, Yiyin was made Pacification Commissioner of the Khitan Southwest.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Yiyin was appointed pacification commissioner against the Khitan southwest.

sentences.zh: 易州刺史安審約奏，戰契丹於北平，賊退保祁溝關，斷其橋梁而還。

translations.literal: Yizhou Prefect An Shenyao reported fighting the Khitan at Beiping; the bandits retreated to hold Qigou Pass, and he severed their bridges and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhou prefect An Shenyao reported defeating the Khitan at Beiping; the enemy fell back to Qigou Pass, and he destroyed their bridges and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，博州殘兵至自敵中。

translations.literal: On guichou, remnant troops from Bozhou arrived from within the enemy lines.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou remnant troops from Bozhou returned from behind enemy lines.

sentences.zh: 周儒之降也，賊執其軍士，將獻於幕帳，行次中途，守者夜寢，其中軍士一人自解桎梏，為諸兵釋縛，取敵戈矛，盡殺援者二百餘人，南走而歸，至河無舟，浮水而過，溺死之餘，所存者六十七人。

translations.literal: When Zhou Ru had surrendered, the bandits seized his soldiers to present at the command tent. En route midway, the guards slept at night; one soldier among them freed himself from fetters, released the bonds of the others, seized enemy spears and halberds, and killed more than two hundred escorts, then fled south homeward. Reaching the river with no boats, they swam across; of those who drowned, sixty-seven survived.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhou Ru's surrender his men were seized for presentation at the enemy camp. Midway, guards slept; one soldier freed himself and his comrades, seized enemy weapons, killed 200 escorts, and fled south. Without boats they swam the river; only 67 survived the crossing.

sentences.zh: 是日，日有黃白暈，二白虹夾日而行。

translations.literal: That day the sun had a yellow-white halo, and two white rainbows flanked the sun as they moved.
translations.idiomatic: That day the sun showed a yellow-white halo with two white rainbows flanking it.

sentences.zh: 己未，滄州奏，賊眾三千人援送所掠人口寶貨等，由長蘆入蕃，以輕騎邀之，斬獲千餘人，人口輜重悉委之而走。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Cangzhou reported that three thousand bandits were escorting plundered people, goods, and treasure into the barbarian lands by Changlu; light cavalry intercepted them, beheading and capturing more than a thousand; people and baggage were all abandoned as they fled.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Cangzhou reported intercepting 3,000 bandits escorting plunder toward Changlu: over 1,000 killed or captured, captives and baggage abandoned in flight.

sentences.zh: 庚申，宰臣馮道等再上表請聽樂，皆不允。

translations.literal: On gengshen, chief ministers Feng Dao and others again submitted memorials requesting permission to hear music; all were denied.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen chief minister Feng Dao and others again petitioned for court music; all were refused.

sentences.zh: 時帝自期年之後，於宮中間舉細聲女樂，及親征以來，日於左右召淺蕃軍校，奏三弦胡琴，和以羌笛，擊節鳴鼓，更舞叠歌，以為娛樂。

translations.literal: At this time, since the end of the mourning year the Emperor had occasionally had soft-voiced female musicians in the palace; since the personal campaign he daily summoned shallow-barbarian military officers at his side to play three-stringed huqin, joined with Qiang flutes, beat time and sounded drums, and alternated dance with layered song for amusement.
translations.idiomatic: Since the mourning year ended he had occasionally had soft female musicians in the palace; on campaign he daily summoned frontier officers to play huqin and Qiang flutes with drums, dancing and singing for amusement.

sentences.zh: 常謂侍臣曰：「此非音樂也。

translations.literal: He often told attending officials: "This is not music.
translations.idiomatic: He often told his attendants, "This is not music.

sentences.zh: 」故馮道等奏請舉樂，詔旨未允而止。

translations.literal: " Therefore when Feng Dao and others memorialized to hold music performances, the edict did not grant it and the matter stopped.
translations.idiomatic: " Hence Feng Dao's petitions for formal music were left unapproved.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，楊光遠率兵圍冀州，刺史李瓊以州兵擊之，棄營而遁。

translations.literal: On renxu, Yang Guangyuan led troops to besiege Jizhou; Prefect Li Qiong struck with prefectural troops and he abandoned camp and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Yang Guangyuan besieged Jizhou; prefect Li Qiong counterattacked and drove him from camp.

sentences.zh: 冀州奏，敗賊軍於城下，見舁棺者，訊其降者，曰「戚城之戰，上將金頭王中流矢而死，此其櫬也。

translations.literal: Jizhou reported defeating the rebel army below the walls; men bearing a coffin were seen, and questioning surrenderers they said: "In the battle at Qicheng the top general King Golden Head was struck by a stray arrow and died—this is his coffin.
translations.idiomatic: Jizhou reported victory below the walls; bearers with a coffin were questioned, and captives said, "At Qicheng the commander King Golden Head died of an arrow wound—this is his coffin.

sentences.zh: 」癸亥，以前鄧州節度使何建為東南面馬步軍都部署，率師屯汶陽。

translations.literal: " On guihai, former Dengzhou Military Governor He Jian was made Overall Commander of Southeastern Horse and Foot Armies and led troops stationed at Wenyang.
translations.idiomatic: " On guihai former Dengzhou governor He Jian was made overall commander of southeastern forces and encamped at Wenyang.

sentences.zh: 甲子，蜀人寇我階州。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Shu forces raided our Jiezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Shu raided Jiezhou.

sentences.zh: 三月癸酉朔，契丹主領兵十餘萬來戰。

translations.literal: Third month, guiyou new moon: the Khitan ruler led more than one hundred thousand troops to battle.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou new moon in the third month the Khitan ruler brought more than 100,000 men to fight.

sentences.zh: 時契丹偽棄元城寨已旬日矣，伏精騎於頓丘故城，以待王師。

translations.literal: The Khitan had feigned abandoning Yuancheng camp for ten days already, concealing crack cavalry at the old city of Dunqiu to await the imperial army.
translations.idiomatic: For ten days the Khitan had feigned abandoning Yuancheng camp while hiding elite cavalry at old Dunqiu to ambush the imperial army.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《通鑒》：鄴都留守張從恩屢奏敵已遁去，大軍欲進追之，會霖雨而止。）〉

translations.literal: (Comprehensive Mirror: Yedu Garrison Commander Zhang Congen repeatedly reported the enemy had fled; the main army wished to advance in pursuit but stopped when heavy rains came.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (Comprehensive Mirror: Zhang Congen of Yedu repeatedly reported the enemy had fled; pursuit was halted by heavy rain.)〉

sentences.zh: 設伏累日，人馬饑頓，趙延壽謀曰：「晉軍悉在河上，畏我鋒銳，不敢前進，不如徑造城下，四面而進，攻奪其橋梁，天下定矣。

translations.literal: Having lain in ambush for many days, men and horses were hungry and exhausted. Zhao Yanshou plotted: "Jin troops are all on the river; they fear our sharp edge and dare not advance. Better to go straight to the walls, attack from four sides, seize their bridges—the realm will be settled.
translations.idiomatic: After days in ambush, men and horses were exhausted. Zhao Yanshou urged: "Jin forces on the river fear our edge—strike straight for the walls on four sides and seize the bridges, and the realm is ours.

sentences.zh: 」契丹主然之。

translations.literal: " The Khitan ruler approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The Khitan ruler agreed.

sentences.zh: 是日，前軍高行周在戚城之南，賊將趙延壽、趙延昭以數萬騎出王師之西，契丹主自擁精騎出王師之東，兩軍接戰，交相勝負。

translations.literal: That day the vanguard Gao Xingzhou was south of Qicheng; rebel generals Zhao Yanshou and Zhao Yanzhao led tens of thousands of horsemen out to the west of the imperial army, while the Khitan ruler himself led crack cavalry out to the east; the two armies joined battle with alternating victories.
translations.idiomatic: That day Gao Xingzhou's vanguard was south of Qicheng; Zhao Yanshou and Zhao Yanzhao led tens of thousands west of the imperial line while the Khitan ruler led elite cavalry east; battle seesawed.

sentences.zh: 至晡時，契丹主以勁兵中央出而來，帝御親軍列為後陣，東西濟河，為偃月之勢，旗幟鮮盛，士馬嚴整。

translations.literal: By the hour of shen the Khitan ruler brought his crack troops out from the center; the Emperor led the personal guard arrayed as rear formation, crossing the river east and west in a crescent deployment, banners bright, troops and horses in tight order.
translations.idiomatic: By afternoon the Khitan ruler committed his center; the emperor formed the personal guard as rear reserve, crossing east and west in a crescent with banners bright and ranks tight.

sentences.zh: 契丹主望之，謂左右曰：「楊光遠言晉朝兵馬半已餓死，今日觀之，何其壯耶！

translations.literal: The Khitan ruler gazed at them and said to those beside him: "Yang Guangyuan said half the Jin army had starved to death—seeing them today, how strong they are!
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan ruler looked and told his attendants, "Yang Guangyuan said half the Jin army had starved—yet see how strong they are today!

sentences.zh: 」敵騎往來馳突，王師植立不動，萬弩齊彀，飛矢蔽空，賊軍稍卻。

translations.literal: " Enemy horsemen charged back and forth; the imperial army stood planted without moving. Ten thousand crossbows released together; flying arrows veiled the sky, and the rebel army gradually fell back.
translations.idiomatic: " Enemy cavalry charged repeatedly; the imperial line held firm as ten thousand crossbows darkened the sky and the enemy slowly withdrew.

sentences.zh: 會有亡者告契丹主曰：「南軍東面人少，沿河城柵不固，可以攻之。

translations.literal: Then a deserter told the Khitan ruler: "The southern army's eastern wing is few in number; the riverside stockades are not solid—they can be attacked.
translations.idiomatic: A deserter told the Khitan ruler, "The southern eastern wing is thin and the riverside palisades weak—they can be attacked.

sentences.zh: 」契丹乃率精騎以攻東邊，王師敗走，敵騎追之。

translations.literal: " The Khitan then led crack cavalry to attack the eastern wing; the imperial army was defeated and fled, and enemy horsemen pursued.
translations.idiomatic: " The Khitan struck the eastern wing with elite cavalry; the imperial army broke and fled under pursuit.

sentences.zh: 時有夾馬軍士千餘人在堤間治水寨，旗幟之末出於堰埭，敵望見之，以為伏兵所起，追騎乃止。

translations.literal: At this time more than a thousand horse-guard soldiers were building a water camp on the embankment; the tips of their banners showed above the weir and dike. The enemy saw them and thought ambush troops were rising; the pursuing horsemen then halted.
translations.idiomatic: More than a thousand horse-guard troops building a water camp on the dike had banner tips visible above the weir; the enemy mistook them for ambush and halted pursuit.

sentences.zh: 久之復戰，王師又退，李守超以數百騎短兵直起擊之，敵稍卻。

translations.literal: After a long while they fought again; the imperial army retreated once more. Li Shouchao with several hundred horsemen and short weapons charged straight up and struck them; the enemy gradually fell back.
translations.idiomatic: Fighting resumed; the imperial line retreated again until Li Shouchao led several hundred horsemen in a direct charge and the enemy gave ground.

sentences.zh: 戰場之地，人馬死者無算，斷箭殘鏃，橫厚數寸。

translations.literal: On the battlefield men and horses died beyond counting; broken arrows and spent bolt-heads lay several inches thick.
translations.idiomatic: The dead were beyond count; broken arrows and bolt-heads lay inches deep on the field.

sentences.zh: 遇夜，賊擊鉦抽軍而退，夜行三十里而舍焉。

translations.literal: When night came the bandits struck gongs and withdrew their army, marching thirty li by night before encamping.
translations.idiomatic: At nightfall the enemy sounded gongs and withdrew, marching thirty li before camping.

sentences.zh: 護聖指揮使協霸

translations.literal: Guardian Sage Commander Xieba
translations.idiomatic: Guardian Sage commander Xieba

translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

translations.idiomatic: (Text is likely missing above "Xieba.")〉

sentences.zh: 亡入賊中，夷其族。

translations.literal: fled into the enemy camp, and his clan was exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: fled to the enemy, and his clan was exterminated.

sentences.zh: 護聖第二軍都指揮使安重懷、指揮使烏韓七、監軍何彥超等臨陣畏怯，手失兵仗，悉斬之。

translations.literal: Guardian Sage Second Army Director-in-Chief An Zhonghuai, Commander Wuhan Qi, Military Supervisor He Yanchao, and others showed cowardice in battle and let their weapons slip from their hands—all were beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: An Zhonghuai, Wuhan Qi, He Yanchao, and others who dropped their weapons in cowardice on the field were all executed.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，契丹主帳內小校竊其主所乘馬來奔，云：「契丹已傳木書，收軍北去。」

translations.literal: On yihai, a junior officer within the Khitan ruler's tent stole his master's riding horse and came over in flight, saying: "The Khitan have already passed wooden orders to gather the army and go north."
translations.idiomatic: On yihai a Khitan tent officer stole his lord's horse and defected, reporting that wooden orders had been issued to withdraw north.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《契丹國志》云：景延廣疑有詐，閉壁不敢追。

translations.literal: (Khitan State Chronicle states: Jing Yanguang suspected deception and closed the walls, not daring to pursue.
translations.idiomatic: (Khitan State Chronicle: Jing Yanguang suspected a ruse and would not pursue behind closed walls.

sentences.zh: 遼帝北歸，所過焚掠民物殆盡。）〉

translations.literal: The Liao emperor returned north; wherever he passed he burned and plundered until the people's goods were nearly exhausted.)〉
translations.idiomatic: The Liao emperor marched north, burning and plundering almost everything in his path.)〉

sentences.zh: 齊州奏，青州賊軍寇明水鎮。

translations.literal: Qizhou reported that Qingzhou rebel troops raided Mingshui Fort.
translations.idiomatic: Qizhou reported Qingzhou rebels raiding Mingshui Fort.

sentences.zh: 壬午，禮部尚書盧詹卒，贈太子太保。

translations.literal: On renwu, Minister of Rites Lu Zhan died and was posthumously given Crown Prince Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu minister of rites Lu Zhan died and was posthumously honored as crown prince grand guardian.

sentences.zh: 甲申，契丹車帳已過貝州，以趙延昭守貝州。

translations.literal: On jiashen, the Khitan ruler's carriage tent had already passed Beizhou; Zhao Yanzhao was left to hold Beizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the Khitan ruler's camp had passed Beizhou, leaving Zhao Yanzhao to hold it.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《遼史》：三月壬午，留趙延昭守貝州，徙所俘戶於內地。）〉

translations.literal: (History of Liao: Third month, renwu, Zhao Yanzhao was left to hold Beizhou and captured households were moved to the interior.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (History of Liao: Third month, renwu, Zhao Yanzhao held Beizhou and captives were resettled inland.)〉

sentences.zh: 辛卯，定州馬全節攻泰州，拔之，俘其兵士二千人，雜畜戎仗稱是。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Dingzhou's Ma Quanjie attacked Taizhou, took it, and captured two thousand of its soldiers along with mixed livestock and military gear in proportion.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Ma Quanjie of Dingzhou took Taizhou, capturing 2,000 soldiers plus livestock and arms in quantity.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，北京留守、兼中書令劉知遠封太原王，餘如故。

translations.literal: On guisi, Northern Capital Garrison Commander and concurrent Palace Secretariat Director Liu Zhiyuan was enfeoffed as King of Taiyuan; the rest remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Liu Zhiyuan, northern capital garrison commander and palace secretariat director, was enfeoffed as King of Taiyuan; other offices unchanged.

sentences.zh: 是日，詔天下抽點鄉兵，凡七戶出一士，六戶資之，仍自具兵仗，以「武定」為軍號。

translations.literal: That day an edict ordered levying militia throughout the realm: one soldier from every seven households, six households to support him, each still providing his own weapons, with the army designation "Martial Settlement."
translations.idiomatic: That day militia were levied nationwide: one soldier per seven households, six households to support him, each supplying arms, under the designation Martial Settlement.

sentences.zh: 太常丞王緒棄市。

translations.literal: Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Assistant Wang Xu was executed in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant grand master of splendor Wang Xu was executed in public.

sentences.zh: 緒家於青州，常致書於楊光遠，緒有妾之兄慊緒不為赒給，遂告與光遠連謀，密書述朝廷機事，遂收捕斬之。

translations.literal: Xu's family was in Qingzhou and he had often sent letters to Yang Guangyuan; the elder brother of Xu's concubine resented that Xu did not give him relief and therefore reported that he was in secret conspiracy with Guangyuan, with confidential letters describing court affairs—he was seized and beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: Xu, whose family was in Qingzhou, had corresponded with Yang Guangyuan; his concubine's brother, resenting lack of support, denounced him for plotting with Guangyuan and revealing court secrets—he was arrested and executed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，車駕在澶州。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month: the imperial carriage was at Chunzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer the emperor was at Chunzhou.

sentences.zh: 滄州奏，契丹陷德州，刺史尹居璠為敵所執。

translations.literal: Cangzhou reported that the Khitan had taken Dezhou and Prefect Yin Jufan was seized by the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Cangzhou reported the Khitan had taken Dezhou and seized prefect Yin Jufan.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，鄴都留守張從恩來朝。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Yedu Garrison Commander Zhang Congen came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Yedu garrison commander Zhang Congen presented himself at court.

sentences.zh: 丁未，加從恩平章事，還鄴。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Congen was given Grand Councilor and returned to Ye.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Congen was made grand councilor and returned to Ye.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔取今月八日車駕還京，令高行周、王周留鎮澶淵，近地兵馬委便宜制置。

translations.literal: On jiyou, an edict set the eighth day of this month for the imperial carriage to return to the capital; Gao Xingzhou and Wang Zhou were ordered to remain garrisoning Chan-Yuan, with nearby troops and horses left to discretionary disposition.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou the return to the capital was set for the eighth; Gao Xingzhou and Wang Zhou were left to garrison Chan-Yuan with discretionary control of nearby forces.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，至自澶州，曲赦京城大辟以下罪人。

translations.literal: On jiayin, he arrived from Chunzhou and granted a partial amnesty in the capital for criminals below capital offenses.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he returned from Chunzhou and granted a partial amnesty in the capital for crimes below capital offenses.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，升冀州為防禦使額。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Jizhou was elevated to Defense Commissioner quota.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Jizhou was elevated to defense commissioner status.

sentences.zh: 同、華奏，人民相食。

translations.literal: Tong and Hua reported that the people were eating one another.
translations.idiomatic: Tong and Hua reported cannibalism among the populace.

sentences.zh: 己未，以右武衛上將軍張彥澤為右神武統軍。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Right Martial Guard Senior General Zhang Yanzhe was made Right Divine Martial Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Zhang Yanzhe of the Right Martial Guard was made Right Divine Martial commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以鄆州節度使、侍衛親軍都指揮使景延廣為西京留守；

translations.literal: On xinyou, Yunzhou Military Governor and Personal Guard Director-in-Chief Jing Yanguang was made Western Capital Garrison Commander;
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Yunzhou governor and personal guard commander Jing Yanguang was made western capital garrison commander;

sentences.zh: 以宋州節度使高行周為侍衛親軍都指揮使；

translations.literal: Songzhou Military Governor Gao Xingzhou was made Personal Guard Director-in-Chief;
translations.idiomatic: Gao Xingzhou of Songzhou was made personal guard commander-in-chief;

sentences.zh: 以侍衛親軍都虞候、義成軍節度使李守貞為兗州節度使，典軍如故。

translations.literal: Personal Guard Chief Controller and Yicheng Army Military Governor Li Shouzhen was made Yanzhou Military Governor, continuing to command troops as before.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shouzhen, personal guard chief controller and Yicheng governor, was made Yanzhou governor while retaining troop command.

sentences.zh: 是日，分命文武臣僚三十六人往諸道州府括率錢帛，以次軍用。

translations.literal: That day thirty-six civil and military officials were separately assigned to the various circuits and prefectures to levy money and silk in sequence for military use.
translations.idiomatic: That day thirty-six officials were dispatched to levy money and silk from the circuits for the army.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以西京留守安彥威為晉昌軍節度使，以晉昌軍節度使趙瑩為華州節度使，以左龍武統軍皇甫遇為滑州節度使。

translations.literal: On guihai, Western Capital Garrison Commander An Yanwei was made Jinchang Army Military Governor; Jinchang Army Military Governor Zhao Ying was made Huazhou Military Governor; Left Dragon Martial Commander-in-Chief Huangfu Yu was made Hua Prefecture Military Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai An Yanwei was transferred from western capital to Jinchang Army, Zhao Ying from Jinchang to Huazhou, and Huangfu Yu from Left Dragon Martial to Hua prefecture.

sentences.zh: 是日，置酒宮中，召景延廣謂之曰：「卿有佐命之功，命保釐伊、洛，非酬勛之地也。

translations.literal: That day wine was set out in the palace; Jing Yanguang was summoned and told: "You have merit in aiding the Mandate; ordering you to guard and settle Yi and Luo is not a place for rewarding merit.
translations.idiomatic: That day at a palace feast the emperor told Jing Yanguang, "Your merit in founding the dynasty warrants guarding Yi and Luo—not merely a reward posting.

sentences.zh: 」因解禦衣、寶帶以賜之。

translations.literal: " He then removed his imperial robe and precious belt to grant them.
translations.idiomatic: " He then gave him his own robe and jade belt.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，隴州奏，餓死者五萬六千口。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Longzhou reported fifty-six thousand who had starved to death.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Longzhou reported 56,000 starvation deaths.

sentences.zh: 五月壬申朔，太原劉知遠奏，邊境未寧，軍用甚廣，所封王爵，乞未行冊命。

translations.literal: Fifth month, renshen new moon: Taiyuan's Liu Zhiyuan memorialized that the border was not yet settled and military expenses were very great; regarding the enfeoffed royal title, he begged that the investiture ceremony not yet be carried out.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen new moon in the fifth month Liu Zhiyuan of Taiyuan reported the border unsettled and military costs heavy, asking to defer the enfeoffment ceremony for his new royal title.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，遣侍衛親軍都虞候李守貞率步騎二萬，討楊光遠於青州。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Personal Guard Chief Controller Li Shouzhen was sent to lead twenty thousand foot and horse to suppress Yang Guangyuan at Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Li Shouzhen was sent with 20,000 infantry and cavalry to suppress Yang Guangyuan at Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以鄴都留守張從恩為貝州行營都部署，

translations.literal: On dinghai, Yedu Garrison Commander Zhang Congen was made Overall Commander of the Beizhou Campaign Headquarters,
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Yedu garrison commander Zhang Congen was made overall commander of the Beizhou campaign,

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《通鑒》：張從恩上言：「趙延昭雖據貝州，麾下將士久客思歸，宜速進軍攻擊。

translations.literal: (Comprehensive Mirror: Zhang Congen submitted: "Although Zhao Yanzhao holds Beizhou, the officers and soldiers under him have long been guests and yearn to return—we should advance quickly to attack.
translations.idiomatic: (Comprehensive Mirror: Zhang Congen urged, "Though Zhao Yanzhao holds Beizhou, his troops long abroad yearn for home—we should attack at once.

sentences.zh: 」詔以從恩為貝州行營都部署。）〉

translations.literal: " An edict made Congen Overall Commander of the Beizhou Campaign Headquarters.)〉
translations.idiomatic: " Congen was appointed overall commander of the Beizhou campaign.)〉

sentences.zh: 以滑州節度使皇甫遇為行營都虞候，以左神武統軍潘環掌騎兵，右神武統軍張彥澤掌步兵。

translations.literal: Hua Prefecture Military Governor Huangfu Yu was made Campaign Chief Controller; Left Divine Martial Commander-in-Chief Pan Huan commanded cavalry; Right Divine Martial Commander-in-Chief Zhang Yanzhe commanded infantry.
translations.idiomatic: Huangfu Yu of Hua prefecture was chief controller; Pan Huan commanded cavalry and Zhang Yanzhe infantry.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，張從恩奏，貝州賊將趙延昭縱火大掠，棄城而遁。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Zhang Congen reported that Beizhou rebel general Zhao Yanzhao set fires and plundered greatly, then abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Zhang Congen reported Zhao Yanzhao had burned and plundered Beizhou, then abandoned the city and fled.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《通鑒》：延昭屯於瀛、莫，阻水自固。）〉

translations.literal: (Comprehensive Mirror: Yanzhao encamped at Ying and Mo, using water barriers to secure himself.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (Comprehensive Mirror: Yanzhao held Ying and Mo behind water barriers.)〉

sentences.zh: 以李守貞為青州行營都部署，以河陽節度使符彥卿副之。

translations.literal: Li Shouzhen was made Overall Commander of the Qingzhou Campaign Headquarters; Heyang Military Governor Fu Yanqing served as his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shouzhen was made overall commander of the Qingzhou campaign with Fu Yanqing of Heyang as deputy.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以鄧州節度使何建為貝州永清軍節度使。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Dengzhou Military Governor He Jian was made Beizhou Yongqing Army Military Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Dengzhou governor He Jian was made military governor of Beizhou Yongqing Army.

sentences.zh: 是月，澤潞上言，餓死者凡五千餘人。

translations.literal: That month Ze-Lu reported more than five thousand who had starved to death.
translations.idiomatic: That month Ze-Lu reported over 5,000 starvation deaths.

sentences.zh: 六月辛丑朔，王師拔淄州，斬楊光遠偽署刺史劉翰。

translations.literal: Sixth month, xinchou new moon: the imperial army took Zizhou and beheaded Liu Han, whom Yang Guangyuan had falsely appointed prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou new moon in the sixth month the imperial army took Zizhou and executed Liu Han, Yang Guangyuan's puppet prefect.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以太尉、兼侍中馮道為檢校太師、兼侍中，充同州節度使。

translations.literal: On guimao, Grand Commandant and concurrent Palace Attendant Feng Dao was made Acting Grand Preceptor and concurrent Palace Attendant, assigned as Tongzhou Military Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao grand commandant Feng Dao was made acting grand preceptor and military governor of Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔復置樞密院。

translations.literal: On bingwu, an edict restored the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the Bureau of Military Affairs was restored by edict.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以侍中桑維翰為中書令，充樞密使。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Palace Attendant Sang Weihan was made Director of the Secretariat and assigned as Bureau of Military Affairs Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei palace attendant Sang Weihan was made director of the Secretariat and military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 權開封府尹李周卒，輟朝，贈太師。

translations.literal: Acting Kaifeng Prefect Li Zhou died; court was suspended; he was posthumously given Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Acting Kaifeng prefect Li Zhou died; court mourning was observed and he was posthumously honored as grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以邢州節度使安叔千為晉州節度使，加同平章事；

translations.literal: On xinhai, Xingzhou Military Governor An Shuqian was made Jinzhou Military Governor and given concurrent Grand Councilor;
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Xingzhou governor An Shuqian was made Jinzhou governor and grand councilor;

sentences.zh: 以晉州節度使宋彥筠為陜州節度使；

translations.literal: Jinzhou Military Governor Song Yanyun was made Shaanzhou Military Governor;
translations.idiomatic: Song Yanyun of Jinzhou was made military governor of Shaanzhou;

sentences.zh: 以吏部郎中李穀充樞密直學士。

translations.literal: Bureau Director of the Ministry of Personnel Li Gu was made Academician Direct of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Li Gu of the Ministry of Personnel was made direct academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，滑州河決，漂註曹、單、濮、鄆等州之境，環梁山合於汶、濟。

translations.literal: On bingchen, the Yellow River burst its banks at Hua Prefecture, flooding and pouring into the territories of Cao, Shan, Pu, Yun, and other prefectures; encircling Liangshan it joined the Wen and Ji rivers.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the Yellow River broke at Hua prefecture, flooding Cao, Shan, Pu, Yun, and other prefectures; waters around Liangshan merged with the Wen and Ji.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《宋史·楊昭儉傳》：河決數郡，大發丁夫，以本部帥董其役，既而塞之。

translations.literal: (History of Song, Biography of Yang Zhaojian: The river burst in several commanderies; corvée laborers were levied in great numbers, and the commander of this circuit supervised the work until it was finally blocked.
translations.idiomatic: (History of Song, Biography of Yang Zhaojian: The river broke across several commanderies; corvée was levied en masse under the circuit commander until the breach was sealed.

sentences.zh: 晉少主喜，詔立碑紀其事。

translations.literal: The Later Jin young lord was pleased and ordered a stele erected to record the affair.
translations.idiomatic: The Later Jin young emperor was pleased and ordered a commemorative stele.

sentences.zh: 昭儉表諫曰：「陛下刻石紀功，不若降哀痛之詔；

translations.literal: Zhaojian submitted a remonstrance saying: "Your Majesty, carving stone to record merit is not as good as issuing an edict of grief and pain;
translations.idiomatic: Zhaojian remonstrated: "Your Majesty, a stele recording merit is less fitting than an edict of grief and repentance;

sentences.zh: 摛翰頌美，不若頒罪己之文。

translations.literal: wielding the brush to praise beauty is not as good as promulgating a text confessing fault.
translations.idiomatic: praise in prose is less fitting than publishing a confession of fault.

sentences.zh: 」言甚切至，少主嗟賞之，卒罷其事。）〉

translations.literal: " His words were very earnest; the young lord sighed in admiration and finally abandoned the matter.)〉
translations.idiomatic: " His words were earnest; the young emperor admired them and abandoned the stele.)〉

sentences.zh: 戊午，升府州為團練使額。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Fuzhou was elevated to Training Commissioner quota.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Fuzhou was elevated to training commissioner status.

sentences.zh: 庚申，襄州獻白鵲。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Xiangzhou presented a white magpie.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Xiangzhou presented a white magpie.

sentences.zh: 甲子，復置翰林學士。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Hanlin Academicians were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Hanlin academicians were restored.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，宰臣等三上表請聽樂，詔允之。

translations.literal: On yichou, chief ministers and others submitted memorials three times requesting permission to hear music; an edict granted it.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou the chief ministers petitioned three times for court music and were granted permission.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以門下侍郎王松為左丞；

translations.literal: On wuchen, Vice Director of the Chancellery Wang Song was made Left Vice Director;
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Wang Song of the Chancellery was made left vice director;

sentences.zh: 以右丞王易簡為吏部侍郎；

translations.literal: Right Vice Director Wang Yijian was made Vice Minister of Personnel;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yijian, right vice director, was made vice minister of personnel;

sentences.zh: 以右散騎常侍蕭願為秘書監；

translations.literal: Right Regular Cavalry Attendant Xiao Yuan was made Director of the Secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Yuan, Right Regular Cavalry Attendant, was made director of the Secretariat;

sentences.zh: 以右諫議大夫王仁裕為給事中；

translations.literal: Right Remonstrance Grandee Wang Renyu was made Attendant within the Yellow Gate;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Renyu was promoted to Attendant within the Yellow Gate;

sentences.zh: 以給事中李式為左散騎常侍；

translations.literal: Attendant within the Yellow Gate Li Shi was made Left Regular Cavalry Attendant;
translations.idiomatic: Li Shi was made Left Regular Cavalry Attendant;

sentences.zh: 以金部郎中、知制誥徐臺符為翰林學士；

translations.literal: Bureau Director of the Gold Department and Secretariat Drafter Xu Taifu was made Hanlin Academician;
translations.idiomatic: Xu Taifu of the Gold Department, drafter of edicts, was made Hanlin academician;

sentences.zh: 以禮部郎中李浣本官知制誥，充翰林學士；

translations.literal: Bureau Director of the Rites Department Li Huan retained his original office as Secretariat Drafter and was made Hanlin Academician;
translations.idiomatic: Li Huan of the Rites Department was made drafter of edicts and Hanlin academician;

sentences.zh: 以刑部郎中劉溫叟改都官郎中，充翰林學士；

translations.literal: Bureau Director of the Justice Department Liu Wensou was transferred to Bureau Director of the Capital Office and made Hanlin Academician;
translations.idiomatic: Liu Wensou of the Justice Department was transferred to the Capital Office and made Hanlin academician;

sentences.zh: 以主客員外郎範質充翰林學士；

translations.literal: Outer Assistant of the Bureau of Receptions Fan Zhi was made Hanlin Academician;
translations.idiomatic: Fan Zhi of the Bureau of Receptions was made Hanlin academician;

sentences.zh: 御史張宜改倉部員外郎、知制誥。

translations.literal: Censor Zhang Yi was transferred to Outer Assistant of the Granary Department and Secretariat Drafter.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Zhang Yi was made outer assistant of the Granary Department and drafter of edicts.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以前晉州節度使周密為左龍武統軍，以同州節度使李懷忠為左羽林統軍。

translations.literal: On gengwu, former Jinzhou Military Governor Zhou Mi was made Left Dragon Martial Commander-in-Chief; Tongzhou Military Governor Li Huaizhong was made Left Forest Army Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu former Jinzhou governor Zhou Mi was appointed Left Dragon Martial commander-in-chief and Li Huaizhong of Tongzhou Left Forest Army commander-in-chief.
